title: Downgrade Difference Refund on Northgate Plus Memberships
content:
A membership of Northgate Memberships that leaves its Plus tier for its base tier during a membership year it has already paid at the Plus fee gets the Plus premium of that year back as a downgrade difference refund, booked against the current year's renewal charge and returned to that charge's tender.

## Prerequisite clause

The downgrade difference refund is not booked until the membership's tier stands at the base tier its confirmed guarantee claim moved it to.

## What the refund write records

Member services books the downgrade difference refund. One call records the refund on the membership ledger against the stated renewal fee charge of the stated membership year, returned to the stated tender; nothing else on the membership changes. The member sees the refund on the ledger and on the tender it is returned to.

## Invocation

The tool is `refund_downgrade_difference_0adda8cc`, an agent-side tool: member services unlocks it and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `membership_id` | the membership reference number, as returned by the membership lookup | identifier |
| `source_txn_id` | the reference number of the renewal fee charge the refund is booked against, as returned by the membership ledger lookup | identifier |
| `term_end_date` | the last day of the membership year the refunded charge paid for | calendar date YYYY-MM-DD, local club date, never empty |
| `refund_amount` | the refund amount | USD with 2 decimal places, always positive; stored rounded half up to 2 decimal places as passed |
| `tender` | where the refund is returned | one of the tender codes below |

`tender` takes exactly one of:
  - `cash_or_debit` — back to the debit card or as cash when the charge was paid that way;
  - `northgate_visa` — back to the member's Northgate Rewards Visa card;
  - `northgate_store_card` — back to the member's Northgate Store Card;
  - `other_credit_card` — back to the other credit card the charge was paid with;
  - `shop_card` — onto a Northgate Shop Card;
  - `reward_certificate` — never used for a refund destination, only for charges paid with a certificate;
  - `not_applicable` — never used for a refund, only for entries that carry no payment.

## Return

A text receipt reading "Downgrade difference refunded", followed by the refund entry reference on the membership ledger, the charge it is booked against, the amount in USD with 2 decimals, the tender and the membership year end (YYYY-MM-DD). A receipt starting "Downgrade difference refunded" means the refund is on the ledger.

## Points of reference

- *Which charge carries the refund?* The current year's renewal charge.
- *Where does the money go?* Back to that charge's tender.
